purpose: Diagnose the V19DL Bullet one-temperature failure with one cluster-label-free minimal-adequate thermal-mixture rule before considering all-region production.

mixture.redshift_rule: both components fixed to the same registered optical redshift
mixture.abundance_rule: one free abundance tied exactly across both components

decision.rule: For every cluster, retain the one-temperature model if its frozen reduced statistic is at most 1.5. Otherwise admit two temperatures only if the two-temperature reduced statistic is at most 1.5, delta BIC versus one temperature is at most -10, both components carry at least 5 percent of total normalization, temperatures differ by at least a factor 1.2, and every free parameter is strictly inside its inherited bound.
decision.pass: Both clusters have a minimal adequate integrated model under the identical rule and both registered regions pass after refitting with the selected integrated abundance. A separately named all-region successor may be frozen.
decision.fail: Do not run all regions or alter the mixture after seeing the result. Retain the diagnostic and reconsider the temperature-distribution observation model.

claim_boundary: V19DM is a post-failure X-ray observation-model diagnostic, not a Sigma source or gravity result.
The rule uses fit adequacy and complexity penalties, never cluster identity, lensing, halo maps, source invariants or gravity outcomes.
No I4, I5, lensing, halo, action, gravity parameter or holdout payload is opened.
A pass authorizes only a separately frozen full-regional spectral successor.
